answer: Stable channel: the OpenAI Python SDK is on the 1.x major line (stable on PyPI under the package name "openai"). Cadence: releases are frequent—typically weekly to biweekly, with several (roughly 2–6) releases per month, plus ad‑hoc patches. Note: my last confirmed view is as of 2024-10; verify on PyPI or the GitHub Releases page for any move to 2.x or newer.

findings.detail: As of the latest public information available to me (2024-10), the official OpenAI Python SDK’s stable major version is 1.x.
The stable SDK is published to PyPI under the package name "openai"; this is the default (non–pre-release) channel.
Pre-releases, when present, are explicitly marked on PyPI; the default install channel is stable, tracking the latest 1.x.
In 2024 the project shipped updates frequently—often weekly—resulting in several releases per month (roughly 2–6), including minor and patch updates.
The SDK transitioned from 0.x to 1.x around late 2023; current docs and the repository README reference the v1 client usage.
